text.text: In computing, a shell is just the interface people use to control a system — the outer layer that shows what's going on and lets you act. Ketrik is that shell for your business: the live control panel sitting on top of your data and workflows.

shellfaq.question: Is Ketrik a dashboard tool, a workflow tool, or an AI tool?
shellfaq.answer: It’s the shell — the live interface that sits on top of all three. You or your data experts define how data and workflows work; Ketrik turns that into dashboards, alerts, and a command center you can actually use every day.

shellfaq.question: Do I need to be technical to use it?
shellfaq.answer: No. You see clear numbers, alerts, and actions. The technical work—models, pipelines, custom metrics — can be done by us, your consultant, or your data scientist and then plugged into Ketrik.

shellfaq.question: How long until we see a live shell?
shellfaq.answer: Deployed within 24 hours and ready to accept your metrics whenever your data is prepared. Core views and alerts go live on day one, while deeper customization depends on your data complexity.

shellfaq.question: Where does Ketrik run, and is raw client data kept secure?
shellfaq.answer: By default, Ketrik uses Google Cloud (GCP) for high-speed caching, real-time sync, and access control, with options to deploy inside your own cloud account or custom infrastructure. By design, raw data stays inside your existing systems—Ketrik only processes and displays lightweight metrics, alerts, and summarized data. Client environments remain strictly isolated, with full support for private VPN connections and custom network security.

text.text: The autonomous engine inside your shell. While you monitor the big picture, Ketrik AI Agents work behind the scenes—routing data, updating systems, and executing routine operations across your business automatically.

agentfaq.question: Are Ketrik agents fully autonomous?
agentfaq.answer: They can act on their own, but within the guardrails you set. You choose which workflows agents can trigger, when they must ask for approval, and what they’re allowed to change.

agentfaq.question: What do Ketrik agents actually do day to day?
agentfaq.answer: Agents watch your metrics and events, spot issues, and kick off the workflows you’ve defined — updating systems, sending alerts, and surfacing decisions in the Ketrik shell so you can see what’s happening.

agentfaq.question: Can I start without agents and add them later?
agentfaq.answer: Yes. Many teams start with the Ketrik shell as a live command center, then introduce agents gradually for specific tasks like risk monitoring, follow‑ups, or routing incidents.

text.text: We started Ketrik on a simple premise: operational systems should adapt, not require rebuilding. Our schema-driven shell wraps around your existing data pipelines and workflows, creating a single command surface where autonomous agents help you see, understand, and act.

minifaq.question: Is Ketrik a self-service product or a custom service?
minifaq.answer: Ketrik is an operational MVP built on a flexible, schema-driven platform and delivered as a founder-led service. While the core shell and agent runtime are fully live, we work directly with early clients to configure and adapt the views, data connections, and agent behaviors around how their business actually operates.

minifaq.question: Who is Ketrik built for right now?
minifaq.answer: Ketrik is currently being piloted with brokers, consultants, and SaaS teams who need a living command surface around their operations. We work directly with founders and domain experts through hands-on pilots and consulting engagements—co-designing the shell, event triggers, and agent workflows around real, active data streams.

minifaq.question: How do I discuss a pilot, partnership, or engagement?
minifaq.answer: If you have custom requirements, want to explore a pilot, or are interested in a consulting engagement, reach out directly on LinkedIn. We’re happy to talk through your use case and see if Ketrik is a fit for your team.

text.text: Want to see Ketrik in action or explore how it could fit your business? You can already try our live demo version today.

Ketrik is currently being piloted with brokers, consultants, and SaaS teams, operating as an MVP and founder-led project built in close collaboration with a small group of early users. Rather than offering a finished, off-the-shelf product, we tailor the shell and agent behaviors around your specific business needs.
If you have custom requirements or would like to discuss a potential partnership or consulting engagement, reach out directly on LinkedIn — we'd be happy to talk through your use case.

items.question: What is Ketrik and how does it integrate with existing workflows?
items.answer: Ketrik is a live, AI-powered command surface that connects directly to your databases, APIs, spreadsheets, and custom logic without requiring a full rebuild of your underlying tech stack. It aggregates data into dynamic dashboards, automated alerts, and executable action flows.

items.question: How does Ketrik handle real-time data ingestion and processing?
items.answer: Ketrik uses an event-driven streaming architecture and WebSocket connections to map live feeds in real time. Incoming data is immediately evaluated against custom trigger rules and AI anomaly detection models.

items.question: Can I connect custom third-party APIs or internal databases?
items.answer: Yes, Ketrik provides pre-built connectors for major CRMs, SQL/NoSQL databases, cloud warehouses, and REST/GraphQL APIs. You can also define custom OpenAPI schemas for proprietary endpoints.

items.question: Is data sent to Ketrik encrypted and compliant with enterprise security standards?
items.answer: All data in transit is protected using TLS 1.3 encryption, and data at rest is encrypted with AES-256. Ketrik supports SOC2 Type II compliance, enterprise SSO (SAML/OIDC), and granular role-based access control (RBAC).

items.question: How do AI-guided actions work within the Ketrik Shell?
items.answer: The Ketrik AI engine continuously analyzes operational health metrics and suggests actionable steps. Operators can execute multi-step workflows, dispatch team notifications, or trigger external API payloads directly from single-click action buttons.

items.question: Can I customize the visual interface and white-label the surface for clients?
items.answer: Yes! Ketrik is built with customizable theme primitives. Tech leads and consultants can brand the command surface with custom color schemes, typography, layout bounds, and logo assets for bespoke client delivery.

items.question: What are Ketrik Agents actually doing behind the scenes?
items.answer: They watch your entire business in real time. Ketrik Agents constantly monitor the live metrics, customer events, and operational signals flowing into your shell—spotting patterns, shifts, and risks the moment they happen without requiring you to manually scan multiple screens.

items.question: How do agents know what needs my attention versus routine tasks?
items.answer: They prioritize and filter before disturbing you. Rather than flooding your phone with endless raw alerts, agents evaluate urgency, impact, and business context—automatically handling routine updates on their own and only escalating critical issues directly to your main command surface.

items.question: Do agents replace my current tools, or do they work through them?
items.answer: They work directly through the tools you already use. When an action is required, Ketrik Agents trigger your existing workflows, update your connected databases, and send notifications to your team, executing necessary steps across your stack and reporting results back into your shell.

text.text1: Built Around Complexity, Not User Count

text.text: You pay only for your data complexity and operational scope — a setup fee to integrate your workflows, plus an ongoing fee to maintain them. Never a per-seat fee.

items.question: How does Ketrik pricing work?
items.answer: You're paying for senior engineering judgment already built into the platform — the kind of validation and system design that normally takes months to hire for and build in-house — plus the work to connect it to your data and workflows specifically. Ongoing platform access starts from $2,000/month, which is 5–10x less than the cost of a single senior hire.

items.question: How are setup fees calculated?
items.answer: Setup is scoped to your project's size and complexity—how much data, how many workflows, and how much automation you want running from day one. Pricing is calculated transparently using standard market rates and computed daily rates for the required engineering effort.

items.question: Why doesn't building this in-house make sense?
items.answer: Hiring senior engineers takes months before anything reaches production, while quick 'vibe coding' alternatives inevitably introduce technical debt and unmaintainable code. In-house builds trap your team in ongoing maintenance overhead and infrastructure duplication rather than driving core business value.

items.question: Do we need our own engineers to maintain this?
items.answer: No, but you can if you want to. If you have engineers, they can build and maintain the workflows, metrics, and data connections themselves. If you don't, Ketrik does that work for you — not just to get set up, but on an ongoing basis as your data and workflows change.

items.question: Can Ketrik be deployed into our own customer cloud account?
items.answer: Yes. Ketrik can be deployed directly into your existing cloud environment—whether AWS, GCP, or Azure—ensuring your data stays within your security perimeter and compliance boundaries while still benefiting from our managed maintenance and AI agent infrastructure.
